Game Overview

Linear Ball is a arcade game built around sprint through frantic five-second rounds in Linear Ball, where quick reflexes and sharp instincts lead a ravenous sphere on its quest to consume darting opponents. Navigate evolving, strategic mazes in this exhilarating test of speed and wit, mastering cunning movement patterns for dominance and high scores.
